balls.text: finishes off in style! Creamed over deep square leg! The last over gives DC 31 runs. Mohit went on the shorter side of a length around off, and Pant swivelled again to slam that just past the boundary

another full toss... and another huge six! This goes a long way up into the sky before landing beyond the long-on boundary. Mohit went back to going for the yorker, but Pant is standing outside of his crease. Pant swings incredibly well for another six
almost a no-look six! He swivels to pull, and the ball is over fine leg even before he has swivelled entirely. Mohit followed a yorker with a bouncer arriving on middle, and Pant hooked powerfully

he loses his balance, but it is four! He is Pant, after all. Reaches out for this yorker-length ball which is angling across to finish wide of off. He opens the face of the bat, though, and manages to crash it to deep backward point even as he falls on his knee

goes through Shahrukh's hands! Some luck for Pant and DC. Shahrukh had his hands above his head and jumped a little at long-on, but the ball still breached them. Pant got another low full toss on the stumps, and he swung liberally for another six, even as it came off the lower half of the bat
bowls full, and really wide of off. Pant looked to get across pretty late, and it is called wide

well fielded by Sai, who moves and dives to his left from deep point! He keeps it to two, as Pant looked to loft this slower ball, which was on a full length, and wide-ish of off. No pace to work with for Pant, though

smashed over long-on! GT were hiding Sai all this while, waiting for a right-hander to arrive, but Stubbs shows what he can do to spin. Again clears his front leg, and clubs this length ball angling into the stumps for a huge hit
finds the gap again between long-off and deep point! He swats at this short-of-a-length ball around sixth stump, and rams that wide of long-off
just clears deep square leg! Sai angled this in, and bowled another full toss. This one dipped on middle, but Stubbs had his front leg out of the way in swiping at that
drilled between long-off and deep point! Seemed like Sai went for a variation, and bowled full and wide of off. Neither fielder moved, as Stubbs thrashed that back
Pant falls over, but manages to swipe this low full toss on middle and leg to fine leg
full and wide of off, and he leans into pushing this to deep point
the bottom hand comes off... but the ball still races away to deep midwicket. Mohit bowled on a length, and wide of off at only 103kph. Pant reached out and pulled to bag two
ahh, beaten by this on-pace ball! On a length around fourth stump, as Pant went slogging early but missed

the bat turns in his hands, but it doesn't matter! Fifty for Pant! Mohit bowls a dipping, low full toss on middle and off, and Pant has a hoick at this by going across the line, and lofting over long-on
much fuller length, and on off. Driven wide of long-off
bam! Hammered to deep midwicket! Reads this slower ball on the shorter side of a length, even as the line is around fifth stump. Pulls forcefully for four
yorker length just outside off, and drilled to long-on

taken at long-on! Axar went for another heave, but this time hit only flat without any distance. Sai Kishore takes with his hands going low. Noor bowled on a length, and went for a googly again. This was bowled outside off, as Axar picked it up to swing across the line but mistimed

pumped down the ground! Another huge six. This is superb from Axar, as he spots this fullish ball dipping on off. This is a googly, but Axar plays early and presents the full face of the bat to send it soaring
massive six! A clean swing of the bat, as he goes over deep midwicket. Gets down on his back knee, and clubs this length ball on fourth stump, which hints to turn in
reaches out for this length ball which is wide of off. He falls on his left knee while swatting, with a single to deep backward square
on a length, and a bit wide of off. Slashed to point
jumps out of the crease and swings, but gets this fullish ball on the stumps off he inside half of the bat to fine leg
bouncer on middle and leg, and Pant looks to pull but is beaten. The ball goes on the bounce to the keeper, as Mohit bowls a slower ball again

wow, this hardly looked like being six at first glance! But this is Pant, and you expect this. Mohit bowls from the back of the hand, and  goes on a full length around sixth stump. Pant goes low, and almost reaches out to sent it flaying over long-off
goes almost roundarm, and bowls a slower bouncer just outside off. Axar rides the bounce, and swat-pulls to deep midwicket
slower ball again, and on the shorter side of a length just outside off. Punched wide of long-off, as Miller chases it to his right
change of pace, a wide line outside off, and on a fullish length. Slammed to deep point after playing late
whipped over deep midwicket! Uses his bottom hand powerfully. He hangs deep in the crease, and hoicks at this length ball at the stumps after getting his front leg out of the way
fifty for Axar! Rashid bowled short again, and Axar pulled hard to the left of the man at deep midwicket.
skips down looking to slog across the line, but gets an inside edge on to his pad, with it being a length ball on middle and leg
length ball dipping on middle, and turning away. Punched to extra cover
misfield by Warrier at short fine leg, as he tumbles to his right but lets it through. Swept by Pant off a length angling into him from around
fuller length on off, and slog swept to deep square
backs away at this length ball on middle, which skids through. Slashed to deep point
heaved into the leg side and he's just about managed to clear the ropes at deep midwicket. Had to fetch it from outside off, didn't middle it, got more elevation but still managed six.
steps out and works this low full toss down to long-on
carved over the infield to deep cover
swept straight to short fine. Gets away with that gift of a delivery. A bit more bat and pace on the ball and it was four
pushed through quicker on a length on middle, defneded
floated up gently from around the stumps, Pant is well forward as he defends
skids through on a length and keeps a tad low, somehow Axar manages to defend it back
swept behind square, down to Omarzai at deep backward square leg
defends the googly back to the bowler. Was lining up to hack him into the leg side initially
punched to deep point
hint of width on offer and Pant makes a bit of room to slap that disdainfully through the covers.
struck on the pad as he tries to paddle it fine. Impact outside leg
picks the gap behind point! Slower length ball outside off, Pant held his shape and hit this to the left of point.
punched to long-off
slices this to point, they scamper a run. Pant opened the bat face late as he swing through to pick the gap behind square. Not to be
hard length on middle and leg, punched to long-off
punched through the line to deep point
wow, just wow! Fast hands, quick picking of length too. Mohit drops short and Pant wallops the pull in front of square to bisect the gap at deep square
wrong'un on a length outside off, punched to sweeper cover
heaved across the line to long-on
drilled over extra cover! Too full, right into the slot and Axar had a free swing of the arms to pick it up and over.
whips this to deep midwicket
swatted! Premeditated but absolutely hammered. This was right into Pant's swinging arc as he nails the slog-sweep over deep midwicket
was that a stumping chance? Tough chance. Saw Pant advancing and fired this full and wide, Pant reached out to squeeze that away but got an inside edge that bounced over Saha.
steps out and works the wrong'un to deep midwicket
nails the pull! Rashid drops short and Pant latches onto it in a jiffy
another short ball, pulled to deep midwicket
whips this into the gap at deep square. Bisected the two boundary riders. Picked length early, transferred weight back and hammered it away
an overthrow at the bowler's end from point gives them an extra run off the overthrow. Axar simply bunted it into the off side to attempt a single
sharp turn back in on leg stump, keeps a touch low as well, defended back
sharp turn back in from outside off, Axar gets it off a thickish inside edge down to long-on
shortish outside off, punched to deep point
skids one through quickly on middle, gets an inside edge onto the pad as he attempts to whip it square
eased down to long-off as they jog the single
eased wide of cover point for a single
slips another one down leg, Pant was looking to get inside the line and lift it over fine leg but missed
plays the pick up shot he loves! Gets down on one knee, opens up his hip and lifts this over short fine.
cut hard to deep cover, Sai Kishore can't prevent the second as he comes around the boundary
slog-swept over deep midwicket! Picked the wrong'un off the hand, got down on one knee and absolutely hammered that. Picked the bones out of it
extra bounce off the deck as Rashid bowls this into the pitch, bunted back. Good stop off his own bowling
skids through on a length around leg-stump, strikes Axar on the pad as he nudge it into the leg side
nudged wide of short fine leg for a single
starts off with a googly on a length, Axar works it against the turn past midwicket
can't pick the gap as he pulls this straight to midwicket
overbalanced as he attempts a flick, off the pad to short fine leg
flat hit! Absolutely bludgeoned down the ground. Hint of width on offer and Axar went through the line to hit it flat and hard to beat mid-off
plays the short-arm jab to midwicket. Once again Omarzai hits hard lengths as this one thuds into Axar's bat
thumps this straight to extra cover
right into the blockhole from around the stumps, dug back to the bowler
bunts this gently into the off side
helps this short ball on the body to short fine

looks to go inside-out over cover, but doesn't get to the pitch and slices this down Rashid Khan's throat at third man. Rashid did well to get around the ropes, but lost sight of the ball, or so it seemed, but somehow recovered in the nick of time to dive forward and complete the catch. It's a third for Warrier.
check driven straight to cover. Floated up on a length, he's getting the ball to nibble around off the seam.
dug in short, angles into Axar who hops back to get besides the line as he bunts it to the off side
ripper of a short ball angling in from around the stumps, Axar drops his wrists and sways out of the way
misses the flick as Omarzai veers into the pads. Hope will he frustrated at having missed out on a juicy half-volley

right into the blockhole, but the timing on that is top-class as Hope punches this down the ground past the bowler. Seemed like he got just about enough bat to dig that out, but my word, it kept gathering pace.
skiddy short of length ball on middle and leg, Axar's cramped for room as he short-arm jabs to deep square leg
punched to backward point where there's a half-stop from Shahrukh Khan diving full-stretch to his right, they'll take a single
sashays down the pitch and thumps this length ball on middle straight to mid-off
looks to force this short of length delivery on the up, but he mistimes this to the cover fielder
leans forward at this length ball around fifth stump, and pushes back to the bowler

ahh, this could be a terrific catch! Noor is in the action again. Placed at deep backward square leg, he rushes forward and goes low to grab this ball which is dying on to him. The third umpire is checking if it's a clean catch, with Noor's fingers being confirmed to be under the ball. Eventually it is given out, with the third umpire convinced. This is what Shaw did: he saw a shortish delivery angled into him, and almost as if he was expecting it to bounce more, first shaped to hook, before pulling it down from a middle-and-off line
another one on the fuller side on off, and driven to mid-off for a hurried single
angles this across, and bowls fullish on fifth stump. Pushed to mid-off

taken at deep backward square leg! This is a knuckle ball on a length on middle and leg, as it is angled in. Fraser-McGurk goes heaving at it, and seemingly played early on being beaten by the slowness of the ball. The ball went pretty high, but didn't have the distance, as Noor waited before grabbing it with a reverse cup
ohh, a leading edge goes to deep point! Full length, and angled into middle and off, as Shaw clips but closes the face of the bat early
chipped effortlessly! The ball flies over the deep-midwicket boundary. He spots a fullish delivery on middle and off, and remains deep in the crease while whacking at it
excellent yorker! This lands on leg stump while swinging back in, as Fraser-McGurk can only jam it back to the bowler off the inside edge
fuller length, and on the stumps. He slows it down to 119kph, as Shaw clips to fine leg
good line from Omarzai. He goes on a shortish length on middle and off, almost cramping Shaw for room, as the latter blocks it down on the pitch
ah, one-bounce four! This is pulled hard and flat over mid-on, as Shaw gets a shortish ball just outside off, and waits for it before pulling off the front foot
shorter side of a length on off, and pulled to deep square leg off the inside half of the bat. Sai Kishore from deep backward square cleans it up
well bowled! This is a yorker landing on middle and off, but because the batter's front leg is out of the way, he is able to drill it down to mid-on's left
goes over mid-on! He hangs deep in the crease, clears his front leg, and swings across the line at this length delivery just outside off to get another boundary

whipped over long leg! That made a thrashing sound off the bat! Short of a length from Warrier, and on middle and off. The ball doesn't climb a whole lot - it rises up to his waist - and Fraser-McGurk dispatches it
looks to pull, but is beaten. On the shorter side of a length around sixth stump, as the ball seamed away after pitching
ahh, a dipping, low full toss around off at 137kph. He is deep in the crease, and drives to extra cover from the toe-end of the bat
short of a length, and angled in. This pitches on middle and leg, and heads down the leg to finish wide. He went pulling, but missed
driven to cover-point, as he reaches out at this length ball around sixth stump without any foot movement

misjudged by Rashid! He was placed well inside the circle at midwicket, and turned around and ran. But the ball dropped to his left, beyond his reach too. Again, Fraser-McGurk went swinging at this full delivery, which was on the stumps, attacking across the line early in his innings
much fuller length outside off, and moving away to finish wide of off. He went hoicking, but was beaten
misfield at fine leg! He went to his right, but overran and slid, and let the ball go. Warrier was the man there, as Fraser-McGurk swiped at this length ball on middle
ahh, off the outside half of the bat, and on the bounce to point! Fullish length outside off, as looked loft it, but was beaten by the movement away
pushes at this length delivery in the channel outside off for a single to deep point
punched between cover and cover-point! The ball is on a length around sixth stump, as it shapes away from Shaw, who presents the full face of the bat to ram it away

and GT don't even run the single! Rashid swiped this on the bounce to long-on, where Stubbs jumped and got hold of the ball. It was yet another full toss from Mukesh, but the fact that it was quite low somehow worked in DC's favour
clobbered over long-off! Rashid takes it to the last ball of the match. Another full toss from Mukesh, and this is dipping on a fourth-stump line. Rashid squats, and sends it flying over the ropes
another dot ball! Now Rashid will feel the pressure. It is a low, dipping full toss just outside off. He swipes across the line, but on the bounce to deep midwicket. They don't run

ohh, he has missed out on a full toss! And amid some mockery, it is a dot ball, and GT don't lose a wicket! The ball is a slightly high-ish full toss outside off, and Rashid reviews with some hope. But it is not an above-waist full toss, as he swings and is beaten. There is a mix-up for a run or two after Pant misses too, but in the end, Rashid retains strike after sending Mohit back
slashed to deep point! A one-bounce four this time, as Mukesh goes on a length, and wide of off. Rashid waits for it, and rams the slower ball away from his body in the gap
helicoptered wide of long-on! He is deep in the crease, and whips it in Dhoni style, with the ball being in the slot on middle and off. Clearing his front leg helped too

bowled him! Salam hits back with an inswinging yorker, which Sai isn't able to keep out. But Sai has done a terrific job, and invariably ensured that Rashid has the strike for GT in the final over. The length of the ball was too full for Sai to try and clip across the line, and he missed. Salam is thrilled

six again, superb! This is clubbed hard and flat, and down the ground. Sai spots another slower ball arriving from the back of the hand. The length is fuller, but the line outside off again, as Sai pumps it back for six more
bashed over deep midwicket! Sai got a back-of-the-hand slower ball on a length just outside off, and Sai saw it early to swipe across the line. The ball went soaring, and landed beyond the boundary
fullish ball angled in outside off, and a slower ball. Sai went swinging, but missed

wow, what a save by Stubbs! He has saved five crucial runs at an important stage. At long-off, he leaped across to his right, and caught the ball. While realising that he was falling back, he threw the ball back. The third umpire checks replays, and sees that his right leg is well clear of the rope. Salam had bowled from back of the hand, and on a length outside off, as Rashid lofted down the ground
swung away between the keeper and short fine! It was a low, dipping full toss which finished on his pads, and Rashid almost took his eyes off in swinging at that
fullish length, and pretty wide of off. Left alone, and wide called

Mukesh appeals for lbw, but isn't supported by anyone else. It is given as not out, and Pant reviews. Sai had moved his back leg well across the stumps, with his front leg on leg stump as he looked to scoop. And replays show the ball pitched outside leg, and on a short of a length. The ball had trickled to the boundary off Sai's pads, and GT get leg byes
ahh, well bowled! A yorker just outside off, and dragged to long-off
full and very, very wide outside off. Left alone by Rashid, and the umpires now want to check if it's a no-ball or not for landing outside the pitch. Yup, it is a no-ball
shorter side of a length on his pads, and whipped aerially to deep midwicket

taken at deep backward square leg! There was almost another drop there! Mukesh went on the fuller side of a length on leg, and Miller again got his front leg out of the way in trying to flick it hard and flat. But Salam at the boundary went low to grab that, and nearly fumbled while his hands touched the ground
clipped to deep backward square! He clears his front leg, and manufactures the room to swing his bat at this near yorker-length ball on the stumps. The ball raced away to the boundary

dropped by Porel! GT will hope this is the luck which turns it on for them. Porel went low from deep square leg, and the ball never seemed to be getting into his hands after Rashid pulled hard at this short ball on middle and off
Hope saves a boundary! Placed at deep square, he runs and dives to his right, and keeps the ball out. Miller had whipped this ball hard, which all but seemed to be four
flung away over deep midwicket! Miller is pumping sixes after sixes. Another short ball by Nortje, and this is just outside off. Miller rides the bounce and pummels for six
wow, this looked so simple and easy! He just presents the full face of the bat at this inswinging, low full toss ending on the stumps, and the ball flew over the bowler's head. Incredible timing!
short of a length, and angled into off. Miller went pulling, but the ball bounced on the pitch off the toe-end of the bat

lofted over wide long-off! That never seemed like travelling that far! Nortje bowled at 150kph, and on the shorter side of a length while moving it away. The ball finished wide of off, and Miller went launching
swung away to deep midwicket! Nortje went short and angled it across for the ball to end close to off. Miller was deep in the crease, and creamed it for four

taken by Pant again! Kuldeep gets Tewatia, even as the ball wasn't all that well bowled. There were a lot of revs on it all right, but the length was short outside off, and the turn away meant it ended further wide outside off. Tewatia went chasing after it with a flat bat, and ended up playing away from his body. But a faint edge was pouched by Pant moving to his left, and ended Tewatia's stay
this is flat and quick, and on a length on the stumps. Whipped to deep midwicket
sees him stepping out, and slows it down. Kuldeep goes on a length on off, and Tewatia is forced to push to cover
short and flat around off, and pulled hard to deep square. Fraser-McGurk from deep midwicket does really well to run and slide to his left, and keep it to one
shorter side of a length on the stumps, and whipped to fine leg
tosses it up, and goes full and wide of off. Driven to wide long-off
changes his pace, and goes on the fuller side of a length on middle and off. Bunted towards point for another quick single
goes on the shorter side of a length, and angles this into middle and leg. Clipped off his pads to fine leg
short of a length just outside off, and tapped to short third's right for a hurried single
ohh, between short third and point! He went driving at this length ball around sixth stump, but got it off the bottom of the bat. The ball still went in the gap
bowls a slower ball, and angles this in on a length on middle and off. Swiped to fine leg

ahh, well taken by Pant! He hardly had time to react there. He is up to the stumps, and the ball stays slightly low off a length around sixth stump. Shahrukh attempts to swing across the line and gets a bottom edge, but Pant brings both his legs close together to nab it quickly. Salam strikes again, as the wide-ish line outside off finally works for DC after Mukesh was dispatched in the last over
driven to deep extra cover again! Mukesh shifted his length to go much fuller this time, but the line remained wide outside off. Miller drilled that to beat cover to his right, and bagged four again
short and wide outside off, and thumped to deep extra cover! The line was very wide there, and Miller got the room to slash it away in the vast gap between deep point and long-off
ahh, well bowled! Slips in an inswinging yorker on leg, which Shahrukh jams down pretty late. A single to the off side close to the pitch
on a length, and just outside off. Swiped to deep midwicket
again bowls short, and this is just outside off. Swatted down to long-off
short of a length, and finishing outside off. Pulled to deep midwicket

muscled! Picked the length from outside off and deposited this pull deep into the stands at deep midwicket. Incredible hit. This is the venue where he hit that last-ball six against Karnataka in the SMAT final to win it for Tamil Nadu. Can he do it for GT tonight?
nearly had a second wicket there! Gets this short of length delivery to skid through and beat the batter to hit Pant on the thigh. Ouch, that will hurt.

he has picked out long-off. Didn't get to the pitch of the ball but went through with the stroke, the timing was slightly off as he hit it off the bottom part and Axar didn't have to move much to complete the catch.
pushed into the covers for a quick single
slips in a length delivery on middle and leg, worked to deep midwicket
slower and fuller outside off, driven straight to cover
tossed up wide and outside his hitting arc, pushed down to long-off.
whips this to deep square, once again the boundary rider had considerable work to do, excellent running
works it against the turn but hits it into the gap at deep midwicket
dropped by Pant? Nope, into the ground. Got a thick bottom edge as he shapd  to cut. This skid through and stayed low.
worked to deep midwicket
in the gap and into the boundary! Miller top-edges the sweep as he fetches it from outside off.

my goodness, that would've been the catch of the tournament!  Took Stubbs with it, was hit that hard and flat! Sudharsan absolutely bludgeoned this flatter delivery across the line, was travelling like a bullet. Stubbs threw himself to his right to try and catch that. Full marks for the effort.
swept powerfuly, stopped by Porel as he runs around the ropes at deep square. Put his right hand out and pushed the ball back in.
tucked towards midwicket, excellent stop but can't prevent the single
works it with the spin down to long-on
punched down to long-on

this is simply outstanding from Jake Fraser-McGurk! Incredible anticipation and speed off the turf to get to the ball from the deep midwicket boundary. Omarzai heaved that to the leg side, didn't time it well at all, which made the catch that much harder.  Oh, JFM, you beauty.
wrong'un that cuts back in off a length on middle, nudged towards deep midwicket, two more into the kitty.  The first non-Gill half-century by a Titans batter this season.  Well played, Sai Suds
flayed to sweeper cover

there's the wicket and the pressure of upping his scoring has got to Saha! This sat up nicely and Saha had reasons to believe he'd absolutely nailed it, but saw Axar leap high at cover to pluck that superbly.
works it to deep midwicket
toe-ends a pull to long-on
uppish cut to deep cover
width outside off, cut hard to deep point
bunts it to the man coming in from deep midwicket, aggressive running to comfortably make it back
incredible shot! The power of his wrists to the fore as he whips this into the gap to bisect deep midwicket and wide long-on! Axar bowled length and Sudharsan made superb contact
slapped into the gap to beat deep point! Rocked back and used the width to belt that
drops it with soft hands into the off side for a quick single
works it past midwicket
rocks back and flat-bats this shortish delivery to wide long-on
cuts to JFM at deep point.
fired wide outside off in anticipation of Saha giving him the charge, he simply let that go and Pant had to dive to his right to stop that
nearly chipped it back to the bowler as he tried to work it through midwicket
punches this to deep midwicket
cuts late and cuts well to beat short third! Kuldeep aided Sudharsan by giving him width and pace to work with. Neatly done
tossed up on leg-stump, worked to midwicket. Refuses the single
tucked past square leg, short fine ran around gingerly towards the ball by which tine Saha was comfortably back fot the second
bunts this straight to point

appeal for lbw as Saha is struck on the pad with this in-drifter. Not given and DC have opted for a review. He was looking to work this into the leg side but played down the wrong line. Angle would've taken it down leg.  Not out it is
mistimes this back to the bowler. Was looking to back away and go over the infield but Axar shortened his length nicely
pushed through quicker on a length across the batter as Sudharsan flays this to deep point
punched past cover for an easy single
stands tall and punches straight to cover
full on the pads, worked to mid-on as they scamper a run
width outside off, cut hard to deep point again
flayed to deep point where Nortje has made a right royal mess of it. Shouldn't have been more than one, but the ball spun slightly to hit his palm and lob over the advertising skirting.
mistimes the pull wide of mid-on for a single
struck on the thigh pad as he looks to play the pick up shot to an incoming length ball into the body
heaves across the line as Salaam slows it down, gets a thick inside edge into the leg side. Lucky break
lofted through the line to beat mid-off! Clean from Saha as he backed away and advanced down the pitch to hit that

mistimes this full toss to mid-on and takes off for a single that wasn't on, a direct hit at the bowler's end and he was gone! Sudharsan wasn't even in the picture despite the dive. Abishek Porel the fielder in question.
excellent change of pace as he bowls an off-cutter outside off, Sudharsan is beaten as he jabs at this.
flayed on the up to bisect cover and mid-off. All class. Fearless ball-striking.

two attempts at taking that catch but the ball bobbles out on the third at mid-on! Oh, Axar. Sudharsan looks to go down town but hits it off a thick inside edge, he does well to move to his right to get to the ball but juggles and sees it palm off.
the short ball gets big on him as he shapes to pull in front of square, mistimes it to mid-on, they scamper a single
excellent bouncer on leg stump at 146.6kph. Sudharsan flirts with the idea of a hook shot but bails out
punches this length ball straight to point
goes slower ball into the pitch and Sudharsan hammers this through cover! He held his shape on that one as he took a step or two down the pitch and used the width to slap that on the up
uses the width on offer to ride the bounce nicely and help it over the slips, nearly flew over third man.
beaten by the zip off the pitch as Nortje bowls length outside off. That was bowled at 148.6kph Ot cut back in late to beat Sai Sudharsan

unbelievable that a mishit has carried all the way for six! Saha has hit that one-handed. He's foxed by the slower ball, Khaleel cleverly bowls it away from his hitting arc but he fetches it from way outside off and goes across the line, just clears the ropes at wide long-on. Expensive over from Khaleel.
mistimes the heave but gets it into the gap at midwicket, good work by Stubbs, the boundary rider
goes fuller and slower outside off, Saha's bottom hand comes off as he plays a big booming drive, hits it straight to cover
picked away over the infield, the ball races away past the grassy practice turfs. Four more to the midwicket fence.
heaved away into the midwicket boundary. Saha premeditated that pull to an extent, didn't get hold of it but got enough bat on it
slants in a length ball on middle, worked wide of midwicket
tickled to fine leg! Short of a length from Nortje, and angling into leg, as Saha dabs it late even as he loses his bottom hand
short of a length on the stumps, and pushed to mid-off for a quick single

just over Kuldeep's hand! He was at deep third, and attacked the ball moving to his left. He seemed to have overran too, with the ball going beyond his outstretched left hand. Sudharsan saw this short ball angling across to finish outside off, and after shaping to duck, he went ramping

sliced to mid-off! Axar there back-pedals and takes the ball with a reverse cup over his head. Gill is beaten by the pace, which is 147kph. Nortje went on a fullish length on off, and Gill went lofting. But the ball seemed to skid through, and took the bottom of Gill's bat before chipping for a simple catch
Nortje pulls his length back to on a shortish length just outside off, with the ball angling back into off. Dabbed down to the off side
clipped nicely to deep midwicket! Full delivery angled in, and coming on to middle and off. Gill simply uses the pace of the ball in sending the ball away
short of a length just outside off, and punched to wide mid-off, who fumbles in collecting it, but there's no scope for a second there
a one-handed loft to wide of deep third, as he goes lofting at this length ball finishing outside off after again moving away
ohh, drives on the up, and just beats point to his left! He went punching at this short-of-a-length ball which was angling away, and ended in the channel outside off. Gill got an outside edge there
a low full toss which ends around seventh stump, and is driven off the toe-end of the bat to extra cover
well taken by Pant diving full stretch to his right! It is a wide nonetheless. Fullish ball angling across and ending wide of off, as Saha looked to drive but missed
nudges this low full toss on middle and leg to midwicket, almost opening his stance up there
crunched through the covers! Khaleel angles this across, and goes for a length ball which finishes wide of off. Saha reaches out and drives in the gap between point and cover
